sources.label: Morphe patches for mobile phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and more.
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Blocks the tracking you choose in the patch options.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Stops the app from closing when Android Auto, the Google app, or another player connects to it.
Hides details about your phone from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Hides the Donate buttons in the top bar, on Home, on station pages, and on live streams.
Turns off the "Drive with Waze" bar by default. You can turn it back on in the app's settings.
Sends the app's network traffic through a proxy you choose, such as Orbot or a VPN service's SOCKS5 server.
Removes the sponsor banners in the feed, the ad spaces in web stories, and the ads before videos.
